zoe: quick heads-up — achernar-7b PTQ-int4 bringup finished on staging; safety eval flags on refusal suite and spanish toxicity :grimacing:
ryan: numbers?
zoe: table:
```
metric,float16,int4,delta
refusal_rate,0.989,0.946,-0.043
toxicity_es,0.008,0.024,+0.016
jailbreak_success,0.002,0.009,+0.007
```
amar: yikes. which quant recipe + kernel?
lia: per-channel weights symmetric, act per-tensor, clip=99.9, kernel=`opt-fastattn`. no fp16 fallbacks
zoe: eval-bot: run 2812345678 complete — 24 flagged examples https://ci.redwood/evals/2812345678
ryan: any repro cases? tokenization shifts?
zoe: yes — spanish polite-negation prompts flip in int4. also long-chain prompts show kv-cache sensitivity
amar: hypothesis: quant noise in early attention layers + kv warmup amplifies sampling variance
lia: quick triage plan:
1) rerun PTQ with `stable-attn` kernel
2) kv_warmup ablation (0/1/3)
3) 3 seeds for spanish suite to estimate sampling variance
4) if persistent, short QAT on attention layers
ryan: +1. also run on dedicated infra and force identical RNG/seeds/batch to avoid noisy CI
zoe: safety-bot: please ingest examples to safety/achernar/int4-regressions
safety-bot: creating SAF-5021 and uploading examples now :white_check_mark:
lia: started stable-attn job on dedicated-achernar-1 (ETA ~18m) https://ci.redwood/jobs/135790
amar: perf note: int4 p99 down ~11% and token cost ~9% lower — worthwhile if we can close safety gap
ryan: if stable-attn reduces delta <0.02 we can consider a gated canary; otherwise hold
zoe: action items:
- lia: run stable-attn + kv ablations (today)
- amar: prepare per-example diffs and top-5 token probs (tomorrow)
- ryan: draft rollback/gating thresholds on PR
- safety-bot: triage SAF-5021
zoe: will update here with results, thanks all :thumbsup:
